title: Telangana Chief Minister, Ministers in the Telangana Government and Union Minister meet Prime Minister
body_text:
Chief Minister of Telangana, Shri Revanth Reddy, Ministers in the Telangana Government, Shri Vakiti Srihari and Shri Uttam Kumar Reddy, and Union Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya met Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today. The Prime Minister's Office posted on X: "CM of Telangana, Shri @revanth_anumula Garu, Ministers in the Telangana government, Shri @Vakiti_srihari Garu, Shri @UttamINC Garu and Union Minister Dr. @mansukhmandviya met Prime Minister @narendramodi. @TelanganaCMO" CM of Telangana, Shri @revanth_anumula Garu, Ministers in the Telangana government, Shri @Vakiti_srihari Garu, Shri @UttamINC Garu and Union Minister Dr. @mansukhmandviya met Prime Minister @narendramodi.
